candidates.change_summary: Flip the inequality condition in the first if statement from < to >= to force RState reset even when reserve is not below target.
Flip the inequality condition in the second if statement from < to >= to force RState reset even when quote reserve is not below target.
Delete the first if block entirely, so that the ABOVE_ONE conditional cannot change _BASE_TARGET_ from BELOW_ONE.
Delete the second if block entirely, so that the BELOW_ONE conditional cannot change _BASE_TARGET_ from ABOVE_ONE.
In the first block, change _QUOTE_TARGET_ assignment to use the original _QUOTE_TARGET_ instead of _QUOTE_RESERVE_, so target values are set inconsistently.
In the second block, change _BASE_TARGET_ assignment to use the original _BASE_TARGET_ instead of _BASE_RESERVE_, so target values are set inconsistently.
